# Data downloads on the site: plan, /data page, indicator block (product owner, 2 Nov 2026)

Source for Tasks `com/site/data-pages/data/plan`, `com/site/data-pages/data/page` and
`com/site/indicators/pages/downloads-block`. Written against zohelo main of 2 Nov 2026 (`8db07b4`); the fixture layer
`fixtures/published` has 5 published KPIs and the build writes 10 download files.

## Task com/site/data-pages/data/plan

1. In src/dataPages/downloads.ts import existsSync and statSync from 'node:fs', join from 'node:path', and readKpiSeries from '../published' (keep the existing type import of SeriesRow). Export `type DownloadFile = { href: string; bytes: number }` and `type KpiDownloads = { kpi_key: string; parquet: DownloadFile | null; csv: DownloadFile | null; skipped: 'missing' | 'parquet-over-limit' | 'csv-over-limit' | null }`.
2. Export `async function planKpiDownloads(dir: string, kpiKey: string): Promise<KpiDownloads & { csvText: string | null }>`: src = join(dir, 'kpi', kpiKey, 'series.parquet'). Not existsSync(src) → parquet null, csv null, csvText null, skipped 'missing'. statSync(src).size > DOWNLOAD_LIMIT → the same with skipped 'parquet-over-limit'. Otherwise parquet = { href: `/downloads/${kpiKey}.parquet`, bytes: statSync(src).size }; text = seriesCsv(await readKpiSeries(dir, kpiKey)); bytes = Buffer.byteLength(text); bytes > DOWNLOAD_LIMIT → csv null, csvText null, skipped 'csv-over-limit'; else csv = { href: `/downloads/${kpiKey}.csv`, bytes }, csvText = text, skipped null.
3. scripts/downloads.ts: inside the existing loop over published KPIs call planKpiDownloads(dir, kpi.kpi_key) and use its result: skipped 'missing' → the existing 'series.parquet missing, skipped' log line and continue; 'parquet-over-limit' → the existing 'series.parquet over … bytes, skipped' line and continue; parquet not null → copyFileSync as today, written += 1; 'csv-over-limit' → the existing '.csv over … bytes, skipped' line; csvText not null → writeFileSync as today, written += 1. Remove the imports the script no longer uses.
4. tests/downloads.test.ts: add describe('planKpiDownloads') with (1) 'unemployment_rate' on fixtures/published: parquet.href '/downloads/unemployment_rate.parquet', parquet.bytes equal to statSync of fixtures/published/kpi/unemployment_rate/series.parquet, csv.href '/downloads/unemployment_rate.csv', csv.bytes === Buffer.byteLength(csvText), skipped null; (2) 'no_such_kpi': parquet null, csv null, skipped 'missing'.

2. src/routes.ts: in pages(), right after the 'sources' route, add route('data', 'routes/data.tsx', { id: `data${suffix}` }).
3. src/routes/data.tsx, modelled on src/routes/sources.tsx (same imports pattern, meta() from page = pages.find((p) => p.path === '/data')!, CONTAINER, th/td classes): loader({ request }) reads locale, dir = publishedDir(), catalog = readCatalog(dir); for every catalog KPI with status 'published' build a row { kpi_key, name (name_pl or name_en), href: localizedPath(`/indicators/${kpi_key}`, locale), sources: kpiSources(catalog, kpi_key, locale).map((s) => s.name), licence: footerProps(kpiSources(catalog, kpi_key, locale)).licence ?? null, parquet, csv (from planKpiDownloads(dir, kpi_key), without csvText), citation: citation({ kpiName: name, sourceName: sources.join(' · '), accessed: kpi.loaded_at }, locale) }; sort rows by name with localeCompare(…, locale); return { rows }.
4. Render: <main className={`${CONTAINER} py-16 text-text`}>, the h1 with the page title, a <p className="mt-4 max-w-prose text-text-muted"> with pl 'Każdy plik to opublikowany szereg wskaźnika: CSV do arkusza, Parquet do narzędzi analitycznych. Przy każdym jest licencja źródła i tekst do cytowania.' / en 'Each file is the published series of one indicator: CSV for spreadsheets, Parquet for analytics tools. Each comes with the source licence and a citation.', then the table like /sources (overflow-x-auto wrapper, sr-only caption = title) with columns pl Wskaźnik, Źródła, Licencja, Pliki, Cytowanie / en Indicator, Sources, Licence, Files, Citation. Indicator = <th scope="row"> with a teal underlined link to href; Sources = names joined ', '; Licence = the licence text or '–'; Files = for csv and parquet each an <a href={file.href} download className="text-brand-teal underline"> reading `CSV · ${kB} kB` / `Parquet · ${kB} kB` (kB = Math.max(1, Math.round(bytes / 1000))), separated by ' · '; when both are null the text pl 'Za duży do pobrania tutaj — ' / en 'Too large to download here — ' followed by a link 'zohelo BI' to https://bi.zohelo.com; Citation = the citation in a <span className="text-text-muted">.
5. tests/dataRoute.test.ts, set up like tests/indicatorRoute.test.ts (PUBLISHED_DIR = fixtures/published): '/data' gives 5 rows; the unemployment_rate row has csv.href '/downloads/unemployment_rate.csv', parquet.href '/downloads/unemployment_rate.parquet', href '/indicators/unemployment_rate' and citation 'zohelo (2026), Stopa bezrobocia (BAEL), źródło Eurostat · Bank Światowy – WDI, dostęp 2026-01-01'; '/en/data' gives that row the name 'Unemployment rate (LFS)' and href '/en/indicators/unemployment_rate'.
